title: Bar Salts Blue Razz Lemonade 10ml Longfill E-Liquid By Vampire Vape
description: Vampire Vape’s Bar Salts Blue Razz Lemonade longfill blends the tangy sweetness of blue raspberry with the citrus cool of fresh lemonade flavours. This flavour concentrate offers a perfect mix for those who enjoy a sharp, citrusy edge in their vape, combined with the sweet undertones of blue raspberry. Part of the Bar Salts collection, this longfill is ideal for vapers who love to mix their own juices, providing a solid base for personalisation. Add your chosen nicotine shots for the desired strength and adjust the VG/PG mix to suit your vaping style for optimal flavour and vapour production. What are Longfills? Vampire Vape Bar Salts Longfill e-liquids come with 10ml of flavour concentrate in a 60ml bottle, letting you add your preferred amount of nicotine shots (optional) and PG/VG base e-liquid . This means you have full control over the strength and ratio of your e-liquid. Unlike shortfills, which only go up to 3mg (with 1 x nic shot in a 50ml shortfill bottle), Longfills can be mixed to 0mg, 1.5mg, 3mg, and 6mg strengths depending on how many nicotine shots you add. How to Mix Your Longfill: Understand Your Longfill: Each bottle contains 10ml of flavour concentrate in a 60ml bottle. Choose the Right Nicotine Shot: For 1.5mg Strength: Add half a 10ml 18mg nicotine shot. For 3mg Strength: Add one 10ml 18mg nicotine shot. For 6mg Strength: Add two 10ml 18mg nicotine shots (add less PG/VG Base Mix to make space). Add Base Mix: Top up the bottle with a PG/VG base mix to create 60ml of e-liquid. Shake Well: Shake the bottle vigorously for a few minutes to ensure even distribution. Let it Steep (Optional): Allow the mixed liquid to steep for a few hours or overnight to enhance flavour. Recommended Kits: Depending upon the type of VG/PG Base E-liquid you choose, you can create an e-liquid that perfectly suits your device and vaping style. Use a 70/30 base mix to create a High-VG e-liquid that’s ideal for advanced vape kits and sub-ohm coils , and DTL (direct-to-lung) vaping. Use a 50/50 Base mix to create a balanced e-liquid suitable for Pod Kits , Starter Kits and high-resistance coils, and MTL (mouth-to-lung) or RDL (restricted direct-to-lung) vaping. Troubleshooting: Burnt Taste? Ensure you are using the correct kit and that the e-liquid is mixed properly.
